run_convert_checkpoint_cli: run the CLI to convert a fine-tuned checkpoint to a release-ready checkpoint by removing finetune_config
convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: convert a fine-tuned PyTorch checkpoint to a release format by copying backbone and heads from the starting checkpoint
convert_checkpoint_with_yaml: convert a fine-tuned checkpoint and its YAML config to release format by removing finetune_config and copying backbone
review_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: review the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function that merges starting checkpoint backbone and heads into a fine-tuned checkpoint
refactor_convert_fine_tune_checkpoint: refactor the convert_fine_tune_checkpoint function to support additional checkpoint fields beyond backbone and heads
